name: Agent fleet manager
oneLiner: No one holds this title yet. The pattern it would run — one coordinator delegating work to a fleet of subagents — is already shipping in software.
why: Coordinator agents that delegate to subagents already run in production coding tools
Someone has to own the outcomes of a fleet: the goal, the budget, the review
threats: The coordinator agent itself may absorb the management layer, the way it absorbed delegation
It may never be a title — the work may fold into existing engineering management

claims.text: McKinsey's Global Institute argues that as agents deploy, human work shifts toward partnering with and supervising AI systems rather than competing task-for-task.
AI and machine-learning specialists rank among the fastest-growing roles in the WEF's employer survey, with AI and information processing expected to create more roles than it displaces by 2030.
